hop.rule: the B-to-C fence sorts by whether the reasoner that lost the thing is still present or has been replaced by a successor. The case satisfies both arms in its own words (same session identifier with the transcript on disk past its edge; first half replaced wholesale by a compactor's third-person summary), and the rule carries no test for reasoner identity across a compaction, so the seat could not send it either way and kept it on Compacted.
